description: OMOP CDM v5.4 OBSERVATION table — clinical facts about a Patient obtained in the context of examination, questioning or a procedure. Any data that cannot be represented appropriately by other domains, such as social and lifestyle facts, medical history, family history, and patient-reported outcomes, are recorded here.

fields.label: Observation ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each observation.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person about whom the Observation was recorded.

fields.label: Observation Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the standard observation concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.label: Observation Datetime
fields.description: The date and time of the Observation.

fields.label: Observation Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of the Observation.

fields.label: Value As Number
fields.description: The observation result stored as a number. This is applicable to observations where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

fields.label: Value As String
fields.description: The observation result stored as a verbatim string. This is applicable to observations where the result is expressed as verbatim text.

fields.label: Value As Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to an observation result stored as a Concept ID.

fields.label: Unit Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Standard Concept identifier for the unit of measure associated with the observation.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the provider in the PROVIDER table who was responsible for making the observation.

fields.label: Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the Visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the Observation was recorded.

fields.label: Observation Source Value
fields.description: The observation code as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Observation Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.label: Unit Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the unit as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Qualifier Source Value
fields.description: The source value associated with a qualifier to characterize the observation.
